_comment: Placeholders only (RFC 5737 documentation IPs, fake fingerprints). Copy to bigdata.json (git-ignored) and replace every value. Fingerprints: ssh-keyscan <ip> | ssh-keygen -lf - -E sha256. Exactly one node has hdfsHome: true (HDFS is one file system for the cluster). studentOwnsHome true = chown <user>:<group>, the student owns the home (the SIIT command step); false = chown :<group>, the owner stays the HDFS superuser and the student can't write there.
